Library.Link

  • Libraries
  • About
  • Value
  • Get involved

Hi, we're Library.Link

Growing Library Visibility Together

The Library.Link Network is an open data platform that grows library visibility through a collaboration of thousands of libraries and their service providers. Our mission is to build new pathways to libraries on the Web. Together, we share structured data and connect people with the books they want to read.

LEARN MORE

How can you use linked data to help your library?

Drive traffic to your catalog
Engage your community
Meet your users where they are
Reach new patrons

Already a subscriber?

There’s always new ways to use your data. Learn how Library.Link works for you.
